title: Provenance & versions
summary: Record what an assertion or analysis was derived from and how it became approved.

sections.label: Useful provenance
items: Exact supporting passage and retained qualifiers.
Extraction/mapping activity and model/tool version where used.
Revisions of the inputs that affect the result, such as code, data, schemas, or ontology and shapes where used.

sections.label: Established vocabulary
sections.text: W3C PROV-O provides entities, activities, agents, derivation, and attribution concepts. Apply the principles to existing mechanisms; an ontology rewrite is not a prerequisite.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: A past answer or finding can be reproduced from its input versions and process evidence.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
